description:
• About our brand and products:
SammiBee is a female-founded jewelry brand offering premium-finish pieces designed for effortless everyday wear. Our collections include necklaces, bracelets, earrings, and best-selling tennis sets, all crafted with 18K gold plating, moissanite stones, and nickel-free materials. Prices range from $98 to $149, making luxury jewelry accessible without the designer markup. We ship fast from New Jersey and are proudly featured in Forbes, Elle, Yahoo, and Harper's Bazaar.

• What makes us different:
SammiBee jewelry looks and feels like fine jewelry at a fraction of the price. Every piece is water-resistant, hypoallergenic, and nickel-free — safe for sensitive skin and built for everyday wear. We offer premium gift packaging, a 1-year warranty, and a 30-day hassle-free return policy. With over 2,000 five-star reviews and a 4.9-star rating, our customers love us — and so will yours.

• How affiliates can earn:
Join our affiliate program and earn a commission on every sale you drive through your unique referral link. New subscribers also receive 10% off their first order, making it easy to convert your audience into buyers.

• How to promote us:
SammiBee is perfect for lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and everyday luxury content. Our pieces photograph beautifully and are ideal for GRWM videos, outfit posts, unboxings, and gift guides. Share your unique affiliate link in your bio, stories, captions, or video descriptions. Our best-sellers — the Bee Sparkle Tennis Bracelet, Bee Cuban Link Necklace, and Moissanite Studs — are proven crowd-pleasers that drive strong engagement.

• Other information:

  • 📦 Free shipping from New Jersey
  • 🔄 30-day hassle-free returns
  • 🛡️ 1-year quality warranty
  • ✨ As seen in Forbes, Elle, Yahoo & Harper's Bazaar
  • 🌐 Shop at sammibeejewelry.com
payout_period: Payouts are issued 30 days after order delivery to account for returns. Payments are sent on the 1st of each month via PayPal.
